    Comparing two quotients of one category #

    If every generator of a relation r holds in the quotient by s and every generator of s holds in the quotient by r, the identity of C descends to inverse functors between the two quotients (quotientMap), and the endomorphism monoids of corresponding objects are isomorphic (endEquivOfRel). Used to compare the fundamental groupoids of a ray category P and of P/μ.

    The functor C/s ⥤ C/r induced by the identity.
